title: Jamia protests: Two NSUI members detained, exams to be held online

ai.summary: Delhi Police detained two NSUI members from Jamia Millia Islamia campus as students continued protesting for time-bound student union elections since October 12, with five on hunger strike. University claims vandalism by protesters, students deny and allege police detained over 70 students.

facts.claim: The Delhi Police on Wednesday detained two members of the National Students’ Union of India from outside the Jamia Millia Islamia
facts.quote: The Delhi Police on Wednesday detained two members of the National Students’ Union of India from outside the Jamia Millia Islamia as protests continued on the campus to demand time-bound elections to the students’ union.

facts.claim: Public assembly has been banned around the campus under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita
facts.quote: Public assembly has been banned around the campus under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.

facts.claim: The university has not held student union elections since 2006
facts.quote: The university has not held student union elections since 2006.

facts.claim: Students have been protesting on the campus since October 12, with five of them going on hunger strike
facts.quote: Students have been protesting on the campus since October 12, with five of them going on hunger strike, to demand the restoration of their union.

facts.claim: On October 16, the university rusticated one of the students on hunger strike, suspended two and banned all three from entering the campus for a year
facts.quote: On October 16, the university rusticated one of the students on hunger strike, suspended two and banned all three from entering the campus for a year.

facts.claim: On Monday, the university administration announced that student union elections would be held within 15 days of the union’s constitution being approved
facts.quote: On Monday, the university administration announced that student union elections would be held within 15 days of the union’s constitution being approved.

facts.claim: The administration also revoked suspension and show-cause notices issued to students during the protest and said a committee would be formed to investigate the conduct of security personnel during the agitation
facts.quote: The administration also revoked suspension and show-cause notices issued to students during the protest and said a committee would be formed to investigate the conduct of security personnel during the agitation.

facts.claim: Students said the administration had not addressed all their demands
facts.quote: Students said the administration had not addressed all their demands.

facts.claim: Two students, Ebin Basil and Rehan Khan, continue their hunger strike over the lack of clarity in the university’s order
facts.quote: Two students, Ebin Basil and Rehan Khan, continue their hunger strike over the lack of clarity in the university’s order.

facts.claim: On Wednesday, the NSUI, the student wing of the Congress, said that police took Faizan Ali Khan and Zeeshan Ahmad Khan into custody from Gate No. 4 and took them to an “unknown location”
facts.quote: On Wednesday, the NSUI, the student wing of the Congress, said that police took Faizan Ali Khan and Zeeshan Ahmad Khan into custody from Gate No. 4 and took them to an “unknown location”.

facts.claim: The police took them to Fatehpur Beri before bringing them back to the Jamia Nagar police station
facts.quote: The police took them to Fatehpur Beri before bringing them back to the Jamia Nagar police station, The Hindu reported.

facts.claim: The university accused protesting students and locals of vandalising university property and breaching security on Tuesday night
facts.quote: On Wednesday, the university accused protesting students and locals of vandalising university property and breaching security on Tuesday night.

facts.claim: The university said in a post on social media that groups of protesting students along with locals had vandalised university gates and walls, brought down Gate No. 4 C, pelted stones, damaged CCTV control room, cameras, and disrupted their connections
facts.quote: …groups of protesting students along with locals had vandalised university gates and walls, brought down Gate No. 4 C, pelted stones, damaged CCTV control room, cameras, and disrupted their connections,

facts.claim: A group of masked protesters also reportedly reached the university’s boys’ hostels in an attempt to mobilise additional support
facts.quote: A group of masked protesters also reportedly reached the university’s boys’ hostels in an attempt to mobilise additional support.

facts.claim: The students denied the allegations and accused the administration of staging the vandalism to frame them
facts.quote: [The administration] had erected aluminium sheets, and by evening themselves got them broken and are blaming students,

facts.claim: The students also alleged that university officials had harassed them in hostels by snatching their identity cards
facts.quote: The students also alleged that university officials had harassed them in hostels by snatching their identity cards.

facts.claim: They claimed that the mess had been ordered to shut from November 1 to pressure them into vacating the hostels
facts.quote: They claimed that the mess had been ordered to shut from November 1 to pressure them into vacating the hostels.

facts.claim: Students also alleged that Delhi Police had detained more than 70 students since October 12
facts.quote: They also said that Delhi Police had detained more than 70 students since October 12, The Hindu reported.

facts.claim: The university on Wednesday extended online classes until November 24 and announced that end-semester examinations would also be held online
facts.quote: The university on Wednesday extended online classes until November 24 and announced that end-semester examinations would also be held online, saying that the campus situation was “not conducive for an academic environment”.

facts.claim: Earlier, it had shifted classes online until November 8
facts.quote: Earlier, it had shifted classes online until November 8.

facts.claim: Practical examinations will be held online from November 25 to November 30, followed by theory examinations from December 1 to December 24
facts.quote: Practical examinations will be held online from November 25 to November 30, followed by theory examinations from December 1 to December 24, the latest order said.

ai.background_note: Students at Jamia Millia Islamia have been protesting since October 12 for time-bound student union elections, with five on hunger strike, after the university has not held elections since 2006.
